sites.name: Kon Tum Wooden Church (Cathedral)
sites.event: An architectural masterpiece over 100 years old, uniquely combining classical Roman style with the stilt house design of the Ba Na people.

sites.name: Mang Den Ecotourism Area
sites.event: Known as the 'second Da Lat' of the Central Highlands, featuring a cool climate year-round, vast pine forests, and numerous lakes and waterfalls.

sites.name: Indochina Junction (Tri-border Landmark)
sites.event: The border landmark between Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia, metaphorically described as a place where 'a single rooster's crow can be heard in all three countries'.

sites.name: Kon Klor Rong House
sites.event: The largest Rong house in Kon Tum and the Central Highlands, a cultural community symbol of the Ba Na people by the Dak Bla River.

sites.name: Kon Tum Prison
sites.event: A national historical relic where French colonialists imprisoned communist soldiers during the 1930-1931 period.

sites.name: Pa Sy Waterfall
sites.event: The most pristine and beautiful waterfall in Mang Den, associated with the 'Seven Lakes and Three Waterfalls' legend of the Mo Nam people.

sites.name: Dak To - Tan Canh Victory Relic
sites.event: The site of a fierce battle in 1972, famous for the Victory Monument and Tank No. 377.

sites.name: Chu Mom Ray National Park
sites.event: An ASEAN Heritage Park, home to a vast area of primary forest and the highest biodiversity in Vietnam.

place.district: Sa Thay District, Ngoc Hoi District

sites.name: Kon Klor Suspension Bridge
sites.event: The largest and most beautiful industrial suspension bridge in the Central Highlands, connecting the two banks of the legendary Dak Bla River.

sites.name: Kon Tum Bishop's House (Missionary Seminary)
sites.event: A Western architectural work combined with local materials (precious wood) built in 1935, serving as a miniature museum of the Central Highlands.

sites.name: Dak Bla River
sites.event: The iconic river of Kon Tum, famous for its rare 'backward flowing' characteristic (flowing from East to West).

sites.name: Dak Ke Lake
sites.event: A poetic, clear blue lake in the Mang Den Ecotourism Area, associated with the legend of the Mo Nam people.
